'''Hamiz Spel''' was an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[operative]] assigned to the [[Analysis Bureau (Imperial Intelligence)|Analysis branch]]. Spel contacted [[Pettyr Zent]] of the [[ByblosNova]] cell on [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]] regarding [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] activity.<ref name="ISB" />
